Welcome to Viridian City, the Gateway to Indigo Plateau!

The Leader is a boy from Pallet Town, but he's always travelling.
How was it?\nWere you able to battle the Leader?
Have you been to Prof. Oak lab?
It's located in Pallet Town, it's south of here.
Hey, kid! I just had a double shot of expresso, and I am wired!
I need to talk to someone, so you'll have to do!
I might not look like much now, but I was an expert at catching Pokemon.
Do you believe me?

branches.text: Good, good. Yes, I was something out of the ordinary, let me tell you!

else.text: As you believed in me, I want you to take this.

then.text: Hope this helps on your journey.
